name: Arken File Workspace
summary: Shared Prism workspace layout, bounded asset inventory, conflict-safe checkpoints and verified browser-to-directory transfer policy.
description: Owns shared local-folder policy and native filesystem capabilities for independently authorized roots. The native directory transport provides metadata, bounded immutable file snapshots and conflict-safe writers; platform pickers grant permission. Native root binding associates an authorized physical root with a captured browser connection without replacing the app-wide Open Folder workflow.
